About.headline: Four decades of making travel feel easier.
About.intro: Al-Hashar Tourism & Travels has served travellers from Muscat since 1984, combining nationwide reach with personal guidance for journeys in Oman and around the world.
About.storyHeadline: Built in Oman. Ready for the world.
About.storyIntro: Four chapters explain what sits behind every ticket, tour and holiday we arrange.

roots.title: A trusted name since 1984.
roots.body: Headquartered in Shatti Al Qurum, Al-Hashar grew from its Muscat beginnings into one of Oman's established travel companies.
roots.imageAlt: The Muscat coastline and city beneath the Al Hajar mountains

reach.label: Across Oman
reach.title: Close to travellers across the Sultanate.
reach.body: Twelve branches connect customers with local teams who understand their plans, preferences and the details that make a journey work.

service.label: One team
service.title: From the first idea to the journey home.
service.body: Flights, corporate travel, Oman tours, holidays, hotels, Umrah, visas and insurance are handled by experienced consultants rather than passed between disconnected providers.
service.imageAlt: An aircraft crossing the Al Hajar mountains at sunset

vision.label: Tomorrow
vision.title: Make every journey easier.
vision.body: The aim remains simple: serve the community with dependable advice, clear value and real assistance before, during and after travel.
vision.imageAlt: A traditional Omani dhow sailing through clear coastal water

World.headline: The world, arranged from Muscat.
World.intro: Al-Hashar's holiday packages, priced per adult on twin share as published. Tell us where, and a consultant builds the trip around you.

india.name: India, the Golden Triangle
india.blurb: The Taj Mahal at dawn, Mughal forts and the pink city.

georgia.name: Georgia
georgia.blurb: Old-town balconies, mountain roads and the Black Sea coast.

switzerland.name: Scenic Switzerland
switzerland.blurb: Lakes, cog railways and snow in the middle of summer.

bosnia.name: Bosnia
bosnia.blurb: Ottoman bridges, green rivers and easy Balkan evenings.

istanbul.name: Istanbul and Trabzon
istanbul.blurb: Ten nights across two Turkeys: the Bosphorus and the green Black Sea coast.

trabzon.name: Glimpses of Turkey
trabzon.blurb: Cliffside monasteries, tea hills and the Uzungol lake.

dubai.name: Dubai
dubai.blurb: Skyline, souks and a desert evening, four nights away from Muscat.

thailand.name: Thailand
thailand.blurb: Temples and river life, then the Andaman beaches.

malaysia.name: Malaysia
malaysia.cities: Kuala Lumpur, Langkawi, Penang, Cameron Highlands
malaysia.blurb: Ten nights from the towers to the tea hills and the islands.

azerbaijan.name: Azerbaijan
azerbaijan.blurb: The Flame Towers, the walled old city and the Caspian shore.

greece.name: Greece
greece.blurb: The Acropolis, then white villages over the Aegean.

kenya.name: Kenya safari
kenya.blurb: Flamingos at Nakuru and the great plains of the Mara.

france.name: Paris
france.blurb: Three nights on the Seine, from the Louvre to Montmartre.

sriLanka.name: Sri Lanka
sriLanka.cities: Dambulla, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Bentota, Colombo
sriLanka.blurb: Cave temples, tea country by train and the southern beaches.

kerala.name: Kerala
kerala.blurb: Spice hills, backwater houseboats and Arabian Sea sunsets.

czechAustria.name: Prague, Vienna and Budapest
czechAustria.blurb: Three imperial capitals by road, castles and coffee houses.

scandinavia.name: Scandinavian capitals and fjords
scandinavia.blurb: Twelve days from Nyhavn to the fjords and the Baltic.

qatar.name: Doha
qatar.blurb: The corniche, Souq Waqif and the Museum of Islamic Art.

taiwan.name: Taipei
taiwan.blurb: Night markets, hot springs and the 101 tower.

indonesia.name: Indonesia
indonesia.blurb: Tea plantations, volcano views and Java's highland air.

Umrah.headline: Umrah, arranged with care.
Umrah.body: From the visa to a hotel a few steps from the Haram, one team handles every detail so you can give your attention to the journey itself.

inclusions.guidance: Guidance before and during your stay

Umrah.imageAlt: The Masjid al-Haram in Makkah at night
Umrah.message: Hello Al-Hashar, I would like to request an Umrah package. Please send me the options and prices.

page.intro: Al-Hashar has arranged Umrah from Muscat for families and groups since 1984. Tell us your dates and how many are travelling, and a consultant prepares a package around you.

one.title: Tell us your dates
one.text: Send the month you want to travel, the number of pilgrims and the hotel standard you prefer.

two.title: Receive your package
two.text: A consultant replies with flights, hotels near the Haram, transfers and the visa steps.

three.title: Confirm at any branch
three.text: Confirm with your consultant in person or by phone, and travel with everything arranged.

flights.title: Flights
flights.headline: Tickets on every major airline, booked by people who answer the phone.
flights.intro: Al-Hashar has issued tickets as an IATA accredited agency for decades. Domestic and international fares, group bookings, and changes handled by a consultant rather than a call centre.

points.two: Group and corporate travel handled by a dedicated consultant
points.three: Date changes and reissues done for you

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.headline: Stays in Oman and abroad at rates negotiated for you.

points.two: Agency rates and room categories explained plainly
points.three: Transfers added when you need them

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.headline: International holidays built around your family, not a brochure.
holidays.intro: Flights, hotels, sightseeing and attraction tickets combined into one package by a consultant who knows the destination.

points.two: Attraction tickets and transfers included where useful
points.three: Honest advice on seasons and budgets before you commit
